name: Satellite Dish
summary: Large parabolic satellite dish in 3/4 view with the bowl, feed arm and LNB on a pole; for rooftop, TV and signal scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: ground line: the base stands on y

params.name: s
params.note: room scale: at s = 1 about 600 px wide and 880 px tall; use about 0.4 for a rooftop or garden scene

params.name: anim
params.note: wobble = slow sway, pulse = signal arcs fade in turn
